name: product-configurator
description: High-end 3D product configurators for landing pages and stores, for any product: the product as data (options, rules that explain themselves and offer a fix, pricing, shareable links, undo and reset), stutter-free material and shape swaps, a shop-sheet options panel with every state, camera presets that follow the edited part, poster-first loading and budgets, and cart, snapshot and AR hand-off.
